payload.summary: Backlog item from lived friction (visualjc, chat 2026-08-18): amending a constitution takes four hand-assembled steps — edit PRODUCT.md, git add/commit/push under the human identity, then a long nahel config set inception invocation to re-record the signature — and it is painful without an IDE open. Wanted as a guided 'nahel constitution edit' verb shaped like git commit, opening $EDITOR. Hit twice in real use, most recently the speed-count-game constraint-1 amendment (S17/DAS -> H17/DAS). Charted as roadmap node 9cytvt5f at horizon later. Constraint recorded with it: the verb must refuse under an agent actor in every governance mode.
